value.title: Blue Dart Express Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
Blue Dart Express Limited has submitted the Exchange a copy Srutinizers report of  Postal Ballot. Further, the company has informed the Exchange regarding voting results.
Blue Dart Express Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation

Blue Dart Express Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr Charles Simon Dobbie as an Additional Director (Non-Executive and Non-Independent)of the company w.e.f. November 30, 2026.
